messages:
morgan: Heads up — onboarding hit a weird packaging failure in the sample app CI. pip install redwood-sdk[async] fails on macos arm runners.

morgan: Error: 
```
ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement redwood-sdk (from versions: none)
No matching distribution found for redwood-sdk
```

morgan: Locally on my M1 laptop it worked after `pip install --upgrade pip build wheel`, so seems like wheel/platform mismatch in the lockfile or build step.

alex: Are you using poetry.lock in CI? we've seen poetry export drop platform markers if exported wrong.

morgan: Yup, CI does `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes` then pip install -r requirements.txt. If the exported file loses the macosx tag, pip tries to find a prebuilt wheel and fails.

jess: Also saw the async client types missing — the sample app import `from redwood import AsyncClient` gives no typing hints in my editor. Could be py.typed missing or extras not installing.

sam: Re: types — packaging metadata probably doesn't include `py.typed` in the wheel sdist. That'll make typing tools ignore it. We should check MANIFEST.in / pyproject includes.

morgan: Another oddity: after I hacked a build to force a universal wheel, the SDK connected but retries behaved strangely. When the auth token expired the client retried indefinitely instead of refreshing. I saw repeated 401s until I killed the job.

alex: That sounds like the retry/backoff logic not honoring retryable status codes vs auth. We have an open issue about refresh flow for async client but maybe it's not wired into the new transport.

jess: Workaround for CI: add `--platform macosx_11_0_arm64` to pip wheel/packaging or run on linux runner. Not ideal for onboarding though.

morgan: For immediate unblock I pushed a tiny patch to sample app to fall back to sync client and that got the quickstart green, but it's a horrible DX for new users expecting async examples.

sam: I'll open a short checklist: 1) verify py.typed included, 2) ensure poetry export preserves markers or add platform-specific constraints, 3) confirm async client's auth refresh is wired into retry policy.

alex: tagging @devex-bot to create three tickets and link to this thread.

devex-bot: Created issues: RDW-3102 (py.typed in package), RDW-3103 (poetry export platform markers), RDW-3104 (async client auth/retry bug) — https://redwood.internal/issues/RDW-3102

morgan: Thank you — can someone add a quick note to the onboarding README about the CI flakiness and temporary sync fallback? New hires are blocked by the sample app failing on mac arms. :disappointed:

jess: I'll add a one-liner to README and link RDW-3103. Also will add a minimal repro script for the wheel export case.

sam: I'll pick RDW-3104, will replicate retry loop and add unit test.

morgan: Awesome — appreciate it. If anyone hits this and wants the quick patch, ping me and I'll share the tiny diff.
